name: usosvid
build: build.cmd (WDK 7.1, x86 WXP environment, EXPORT_DRIVER linked as bootvid.sys, shipped as bootvid.dll); not byte-reproducible (PE time stamp, PDB GUID)
exports: VidBitBlt@12 VidBufferToScreenBlt@24 VidCleanUp@0 VidDisplayString@4 VidDisplayStringXY@16 VidInitialize@4 VidResetDisplay@4 VidScreenToBufferBlt@24 VidSetScrollRegion@16 VidSetTextColor@4 VidSolidColorFill@20 (names and argument sizes of the Windows 2000 BOOTVID.DLL the 2000 kernel imports)
imports: ntoskrnl: MmMapIoSpace, MmUnmapIoSpace, MmIsAddressValid, KeTickCount, KeInitializeDpc, KeInitializeTimerEx, KeSetTimerEx, KeCancelTimer, MmGetPhysicalAddress, memset (all exported by the Windows 2000 SP4 kernels)
use: Windows 2000 text-mode Setup with ACPI on: $WIN_NT$.~BT\BOOTVID.DLL only (tools/w2k_stage.sh 8.)
watcher: 1.3: with CSMWrap 3.1.2-usos10 (Windows 2000 ACPI flow) publishes the physical addresses of KeTickCount and KUSER_SHARED_DATA plus heartbeat-DPC entry/draw counters and the timer-arm state into the reserved watcher page whose address CSMWrap leaves at BDA 4FCh; the CSMWrap helper core shows them on text row 24 (src/usos_watcher.h = the ABI header of CSMWrap patch 0011). Console rows 16-23. Since CSMWrap 3.1.2-usos11 (production) there is no watcher page: WatchInit finds no magic at BDA 4FCh and does nothing; the diagnostic CSMWrap 3.1.2-usos11-diag keeps it.
diag: 1.3-diag (2026-10-17): build.cmd <work> diag compiles src/sources.diag (USOS_VID_DIAG): Codex's one-shot BSP NMI snapshot (src/usos_nmi.c/.h, its "1.11-nmi" code unchanged) and the HPET/GPIO _STA signature rows (hs/gs). Only for the Windows 2000 diagnostic setup (DATA ...\Unattended\w2k-diag.txt): ~BT and ~LS, with CSMWrap 3.1.2-usos11-diag. The production bin/i386/bootvid.dll is built without USOS_VID_DIAG; usosvid.c without it preprocesses to the 1.3 source (blank lines aside). Built with WDK 7.1, not byte-reproducible.
